title: Reflection audit
prompt: Given a type, list which reflection operations would break under aggressive trimming: implement `static List<string> Audit(Type t)` returning descriptions for each operation that survives trimming statically: include "gettype-of-t" if t is a compile-time visible type (always true here), "declared-fields" if it has fields (GetFields always works on kept types), "attribute-read" if it has attributes, "constructor-invoke" if it has a parameterless ctor — but NEVER include "scan-all-types" (never survives). The test verifies both the includes and the absent scan entry.

tests.name: audit-kept-type
tests.hint: typeof(Sample) is a direct reference → the type (and its members) is kept; scanning is never provable.
